ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black contiguous region extending from the peduncle into both lobes, forming an asymmetric heart-like shape. High-contrast black mottling and focal spots are scattered across the high-intensity white lobes, with a higher spatial density observed on the lower half of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an estimated vertex angle of 55 degrees; depth is approximately 12% of the total visible fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, higher-amplitude topography including a prominent concave indentation roughly midway between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convexity sweeping from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast white pixels at the distal tips of both lobes, particularly dense on the right tip, consistent with calcified barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, near-parallel dark linear streaks oriented diagonally on the outer left lobe. Two shorter, horizontal dark linear disruptions on the medial right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular defect or missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the median notch; heavy barnacle encrustations on the distal tips.
